verdict.claim_boundary: External paper speedups are priors only. Theseus adoption requires exact local wall-time, state, replay, weak-tail, and heldout evidence.

linear_cross_entropy_station.claim_scope: Synthetic exact-shape compiled forward and VJP only; gradients cover hidden state and tied classifier weights.
linear_cross_entropy_station.interpretation: An exact fused loss still performs classifier dot products, log-sum-exp, and both gradients, so its realizable end-to-end gain is below this 8.25% elimination bound. Memory savings may still matter if they unlock a faster full-model microbatch.

inactive_parameter_state.direct_wall_time_bound: The 64-step route spends about 0.046 seconds per update materializing all model/optimizer state, roughly 2% of a full step. Lazy inactive-state custody is therefore a memory-enabling candidate, not a 26% throughput claim.
inactive_parameter_state.candidate: Represent disconnected zero-moment modules with virtual zero Adam state and analytically governed decoupled decay until source conditioning or MTP becomes active. Require checkpoint-format, per-step rounding, activation-boundary, and exact-replay proof.

ranked_current_lineage_candidates.local_prior: The isolated output-loss station is 1.257x faster than FP32, and the already-tested BF16 full route was 1.257x faster before repeatability rejection.
ranked_current_lineage_candidates.required_work: Implement dtype-general master-to-compute recasting, FP32 loss reduction, dynamic or proven static loss scaling, finite-gradient checks, alternating full-checkpoint trials, 64-step watchdog replay, independent-process state comparison, save/reload continuity, and heldout weak-tail checks.

ranked_current_lineage_candidates.local_prior: The output-loss station is only 8.25% of a full microbatch. Attention already uses fast SDPA; RoPE and RMSNorm already use native fast paths; compiled SwiGLU projection fusion was previously slower.
ranked_current_lineage_candidates.required_work: Time MLP, attention projections/core, vocabulary loss, clipping, optimizer, and state custody without a multi-gigabyte Metal trace. Implement no more than one custom kernel, and only if its measured realizable joined-wall bound exceeds 10%.

ranked_current_lineage_candidates.local_prior: 26.36% of parameters are disconnected in plain-token pretraining and all 28.9M corresponding Adam moment elements are exactly zero, but total explicit state materialization is only about 2% of step time.
ranked_current_lineage_candidates.required_work: Prove parameter ownership, zero-gradient status, decoupled-decay equivalence, exact source/MTP activation, checkpoint/reload, and whether the memory reduction enables a sustained faster microbatch without host pressure.

ranked_current_lineage_candidates.local_prior: Checkpoint publication is 3.58% of device time at 32 steps and about half that at 64 steps.
ranked_current_lineage_candidates.required_work: Wait for 64-step qualification, then require immutable snapshot ownership, exact interruption replay, two-transaction disk reserve, bounded unified memory, and zero swap.

prospective_time_to_quality_candidates.external_primary_evidence: A 1.3B model trained on 101B tokens matched an AdamW model trained on 197B tokens in the reported setting.
prospective_time_to_quality_candidates.theseus_risk: Adds a slow momentum state, changes optimizer semantics, and may not transfer to 57M or this data mixture.
prospective_time_to_quality_candidates.test: Three-seed 5-10M matched AdamW versus AdEMAMix learning curves with equal data, raw compute, tuning allowance, heldout identities, and weak-language reporting. Advance only at >=15% time-to-heldout-quality improvement.

prospective_time_to_quality_candidates.external_primary_evidence: Reported comparable pretraining from 125M through multi-billion-parameter models with roughly 45-50% less optimizer memory; its large distributed throughput result is not assumed on one M1.
prospective_time_to_quality_candidates.theseus_risk: Correct Hessian-informed parameter partitioning is essential; memory reduction may not improve a single-device 57M step unless it enables a better microbatch.
prospective_time_to_quality_candidates.test: Implement an MLX policy card and exact state migration, then compare learning and wall time at microbatches four, five, and six under the same small-scale three-seed gate.

prospective_time_to_quality_candidates.external_primary_evidence: Masked Structural Growth reports up to 2.2x pretraining speedup with function-preserving growth in its evaluated settings.
prospective_time_to_quality_candidates.theseus_risk: Changes the training trajectory and architecture schedule; cannot continue the step-3480 lineage as if semantics were unchanged.
prospective_time_to_quality_candidates.test: Fresh common-initialization 5-10M A/B with exact growth operators, matched token/compute accounting, intervention and checkpoint tests, and direct functional review. It is the highest-upside fresh-campaign design candidate.

prospective_time_to_quality_candidates.external_primary_evidence: GrowLength reports faster time-to-loss at 70M, 160M, and 410M by moving from short to long sequences.
prospective_time_to_quality_candidates.theseus_risk: Theseus already uses only length 512 and 94.73% of dense token slots carry optimizer positions; the local attention-compute opportunity is much smaller than long-context examples.
prospective_time_to_quality_candidates.test: Compare 128-to-256-to-512 against fixed 512 on source-disjoint data with equal tokens and long-context heldouts. Do not advance unless joined time-to-quality improves by >=15%.

sustained_machine_controls.machine_class: 13-inch MacBook Pro with Apple M1 and 16 GB unified memory
sustained_machine_controls.required_test: Add a two-hour sustained throughput receipt with first/middle/last-window rates, host pressure, AC state, and thermal/performance warnings where available. Use an open, stable, well-ventilated work surface and do not use unsupported fan overrides as evidence.
sustained_machine_controls.claim: Cooling and background contention can preserve throughput but are not counted as speedups without an alternating sustained measurement.

finite_next_actions: Implement and disposition FP16 compute with FP32 master state before any custom kernel.
Add bounded MLP and attention station timing; implement at most one kernel if the realizable joined-wall bound is at least 10%.
Test lazy inactive optimizer custody only if it enables a faster sustained microbatch under the watchdog.
Run the finite prospective selector: AdamW, AdEMAMix, Adam-mini, and one structural-growth schedule at 5-10M scale; progressive length enters only if compute accounting predicts at least 15% upside.
At the sprint ceiling, launch the fastest qualified route and continue algorithmic challengers only as isolated fresh-campaign evidence.
